quotes.speaker: Luke Kennard
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kennard on his expanded role and shooting versatility
quotes.excerpt: my ability to work two-man, handle the ball, get your shot off in the middy, and also knock down some threes

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Luke, we've talked before about you being able to do more than just shoot threes, and I thought tonight your ability to work two-man, handle the ball, get your shot off in the middy, and also knock down some threes—how comfortable were you tonight in navigating those two roles?

text_blocks.speaker: Luke Kennard
text_blocks.text: It's just stuff that we've been working on since day one of camp. For me, being new, it's just trying to find those connections with those guys, man-to-man, also obviously the guards that are out there that I'm with. It's been a lot of fun just learning how these guys play. I remember playing against them last year especially, and it was tough to guard, but now being a part of that, it's exciting. Obviously, still some stuff we can clean up, but at the same time, a lot of positives to take away.

quotes.social_post: Luke Kennard on his expanded role in Phoenix: It is stuff that we have been working on since day one of camp. For me, being new, it is just trying to find those connections with those guys.

quotes.speaker: Luke Kennard
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kennard on Jalen Green's playmaking and leadership
quotes.excerpt: he kind of set the tone for the entire game and guys just kind of followed what he did

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Jalen was tonight in more of a handling the ball, more of a making play—how would you assess how he did that tonight?

text_blocks.speaker: Luke Kennard
text_blocks.text: I remember at the just talking about this game earlier this morning, from the Chicago game, we wanted to start the game out today with more energy, more defensive intensity, more aggressiveness on the offensive end. I thought Jalen kind of led us out there today and he kind of set the tone for the entire game and guys just kind of followed what he did. I love the way that he was aggressive tonight and obviously we're going to need that going forward. Me and him, we have a good connection just talking with each other, ways that we can play off of each other, and I think he did a really good job of just setting that tone for us tonight.

quotes.social_post: Luke Kennard praised Jalen Green for his leadership in tonight's win: I thought Jalen kind of led us out there today and he kind of set the tone for the entire game and guys just kind of followed what he did.

quotes.speaker: Luke Kennard
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kennard on team chemistry and offensive ball movement
quotes.excerpt: the way that we're able to play off of each other, but with that, there's got to be a lot of trust

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How important is it for an offense in the halfcourt to have so many different ways that they can go about scoring, and a lot of it being rooted in just like the two and three pass principles?

text_blocks.speaker: Luke Kennard
text_blocks.text: I think just the way that we're able to play off of each other, but with that, there's got to be a lot of trust. Guys being in the right spots, guys moving to create more space for each other, and it's stuff that we work on every single day. We throw different groups out there in practices, just different combinations, because we have a deep team. We have a lot of weapons, guys that can have a big night any night, and we know that. I think for us, just trusting in each other, the way that we want to play, being in the right spots, and being ready to shoot our shots when we can. We don't want to turn down any shots.

quotes.social_post: Luke Kennard on the Suns offensive philosophy: We have a deep team. We have a lot of weapons, guys that can have a big night any night, and we know that.

quotes.speaker: Luke Kennard
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kennard on adjusting to team defensive rebounding habits
quotes.excerpt: we have to be smart about when we do tag, when we do crash the boards

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How are you adjusting to the habit of just getting back versus getting in the mix, and how are you seeing that weigh on an opponent in terms of taking transition opportunities away?

text_blocks.speaker: Luke Kennard
text_blocks.text: It kind of slows them down in transition, but at the same time, we have to be smart about when we do tag, when we do crash the boards. We want to be aggressive, we want to slow them down, we want to try to get more possessions. We want to win the possession game as much as we can every single night. But I think for us, like tonight, when we got a couple in transition, kind of not leaking out but just kind of getting behind our defense, and they were able to play fast with some throw-aheads. It's stuff that we're still trying to figure out, but our habits have been really good. We talk about things and we translate them to games.

quotes.social_post: Luke Kennard on the team's transition defense: We want to be aggressive, we want to slow them down, we want to try to get more possessions. We want to win the possession game as much as we can every single night.

quotes.speaker: Luke Kennard
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kennard on the impact of preseason starting lineups
quotes.excerpt: the first guys out there, you want to set the tone for the entire night

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: When you are starting, obviously this is just preseason, does that help your mental game at all when you go into the game and you're in the starting lineup?

text_blocks.speaker: Luke Kennard
text_blocks.text: When you start a game, you're the first guys out there, you want to set the tone for the entire night. For me, it's being aggressive, competing, playing hard, being all over the place, taking shots on the offensive end, being aggressive in that sense, but defensively just competing and talking and being aggressive. So yeah, I think for me, it definitely gets you going a little bit. That adrenaline at the start of games definitely raises the level a little bit, but either way for me, I'm excited just to be a part of this group and help any way that I can.

quotes.social_post: Luke Kennard on starting in the preseason: When you start a game, you are the first guys out there, you want to set the tone for the entire night.

quotes.speaker: Luke Kennard
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kennard on building professional trust with new teammates
quotes.excerpt: it's about being professionals and coming in here and finding that role and fitting in

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: When it comes to you talking about building trust, how long does it take typically to build that trust with your teammates?

text_blocks.speaker: Luke Kennard
text_blocks.text: Obviously, a lot of the guys that I'm playing with now, they've been playing together, and there's a few new guys on the team this year. I think for us, it's about being professionals and coming in here and finding that role and fitting in and building connections early, and I think I've done that really well. Working with guys in practice, before, after, during—it's a lot of different ways that you can integrate yourself into a system and into an entire organization. For me, it's about being a professional, building those connections and relationships, and I think we've done a really good job of that so far.

quotes.social_post: Luke Kennard on integrating into a new locker room: It is about being professionals and coming in here and finding that role and fitting in and building connections early.

quotes.speaker: Luke Kennard
quotes.summary_phrase: Luke Kennard on his fit within the team's offensive system
quotes.excerpt: I really believe that this is a great fit for me and who I am as a player

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: When you're getting minutes with these guys you're going to be playing a lot with, whether it's Jalen Green, Jordan Goodwin, even man-to-man, when you get off to hot starts as you did tonight, just how much not just confidence does it build within you but also bleed over into your teammates?

text_blocks.speaker: Luke Kennard
text_blocks.text: It shows that I'm willing to, that I'm a good fit, I think. I really believe that this is a great fit for me and who I am as a player and the way that I play. There's a lot of just freedom of movement out there and those connections are huge when it comes to that, just knowing the type of spots that you're going to be in, shots that you want to take. I've played with a couple of these guys—like Goody, I've played with him, I've played with Dylan before back in Memphis—so I know some guys. I've asked a lot of questions about the group, getting close with some guys, and it's been a lot of fun.

quotes.social_post: Luke Kennard feels he has found a home in Phoenix: I really believe that this is a great fit for me and who I am as a player and the way that I play.
